title: The ballad of lucy jordan - Hanne Boel The Trio

lines.l: The morning sun, it touched lightly on the eyes of Lucy Jordan
In a white suburban bedroom, in a white suburban town
And she lay beneath the covers
Dreaming of a thousand lovers
And the world, it turned to orange
And the room, it went spinning round
At the age of 37
She realized she would never
Ride through Paris in a sports car
With a warm wind in her head
So she let the phone keep ringing.
And she sat there softly singing.
Little nursery rhymes that she memorized
in her daddy's easy chair.
Her husband, he went off to work.
And her kids, they were off to school
And there were, oh, so many ways
For her to spend the day
She could clean the house for hours
Or she could rearrange the flowers
Or run naked through the shady street
Screaming all the way
At the age of 37
She realized she would never
Ride through Paris in a sports car
With a warm wind in her head
So she let the phone keep ringing
As she sat there softly singing
Pretty nursery rhymes
She memorized in her daddy's easy chair
The evening sun, it touched lightly on
The eyes of Lucy Jordan
On the rooftop where she climbed
When all the laughter, it grew too loud
She bowed and she cursed to the man
Who reached out and he offered her his hand
And he let her down to the long way
